<template>
  <v-navigation-drawer v-model="drawer" :rail="!extended" permanent>
    <v-list-item
      @click="toggleExtended"
      prepend-icon="mdi-menu"
      title="Menu"
    ></v-list-item>

    <v-divider></v-divider>

    <v-list density="compact" nav>
      <v-list-item
        prepend-icon="mdi-apps"
        title="Summary"
        value="summary"
        to="/summary"
        :active="route.path === '/summary'"
        @click="goToPage('/summary')"
      ></v-list-item>
    </v-list>

    <v-divider></v-divider>

    <v-list density="compact" nav>
      <v-list-item
        prepend-icon="mdi-monitor-dashboard"
        title="Dashboard"
        value="dashboard"
        to="/dashboard"
        :active="route.path === '/dashboard'"
        @click="goToPage('/dashboard')"
      ></v-list-item>
      <v-list-item
        prepend-icon="mdi-clipboard-check"
        title="Open Positions"
        value="open"
        to="/open-positions"
        :active="route.path === '/open-positions'"
        @click="goToPage('/open-positions')"
      ></v-list-item>
      <v-list-item
        prepend-icon="mdi-clipboard-remove"
        title="Closed Positions"
        value="closed"
        to="/closed-positions"
        :active="route.path === '/closed-positions'"
        @click="goToPage('/closed-positions')"
      ></v-list-item>
      <v-list-item
        prepend-icon="mdi-swap-horizontal"
        title="Transactions"
        value="transactions"
        to="/transactions"
        :active="route.path === '/transactions'"
        @click="goToPage('/transactions')"
      ></v-list-item>
    </v-list>

    <v-divider></v-divider>

    <v-list density="compact" nav>
      <v-list-group :value="isDatabaseRoute">
        <template v-slot:activator="{ props }">
          <v-list-item
            v-bind="props"
            prepend-icon="mdi-database"
            title="Database"
          ></v-list-item>
        </template>

        <v-list-item
          prepend-icon="mdi-bank"
          title="Brokers"
          value="brokers"
          to="/database/brokers"
          :active="route.path === '/database/brokers'"
          @click="goToPage('/database/brokers')"
        ></v-list-item>
        <v-list-item
          prepend-icon="mdi-file-document-outline"
          title="Securities"
          value="securities"
          to="/database/securities"
          :active="route.path === '/database/securities'"
          @click="goToPage('/database/securities')"
        ></v-list-item>
        <v-list-item
          prepend-icon="mdi-chart-line"
          title="Prices"
          value="prices"
          to="/database/prices"
          :active="route.path === '/database/prices'"
          @click="goToPage('/database/prices')"
        ></v-list-item>
        <v-list-item
          prepend-icon="mdi-currency-usd"
          title="FX"
          value="fx"
          to="/database/fx"
          :active="route.path === '/database/fx'"
          @click="goToPage('/database/fx')"
        ></v-list-item>
      </v-list-group>
    </v-list>

    <template v-slot:append>
      <v-divider></v-divider>
      <v-list density="compact" nav>
        <v-list-item
          prepend-icon="mdi-calendar"
          :title="effectiveCurrentDate || 'No date set'"
          value="effective-date"
        ></v-list-item>
        <v-list-item
          prepend-icon="mdi-account-circle"
          title="Profile"
          value="profile"
          to="/profile"
          :active="route.path === '/profile'"
        >
        </v-list-item>
      </v-list>
    </template>
  </v-navigation-drawer>
</template>

<script>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
import { useStore } from 'vuex'

export default {
  setup() {
    const store = useStore()
    const route = useRoute()
    const drawer = ref(true)
    const extended = ref(false)

    const isDatabaseRoute = computed(() => route.path.startsWith('/database'))
    const effectiveCurrentDate = computed(() => store.state.effectiveCurrentDate)

    const toggleExtended = () => {
      extended.value = !extended.value
    }

    const goToPage = (routePath) => {
      if (!isDatabaseRoute.value && routePath !== '/profile') {
        extended.value = false
      }
    }

    return {
      drawer,
      extended,
      isDatabaseRoute,
      effectiveCurrentDate,
      route,
      toggleExtended,
      goToPage,
    }
  },
}
</script>
